question_text: Define superclass in an inheritance relationship.
adaptation_rationale: Repairs source parent-object terminology to superclass; classes, not ordinary parent instances, define inherited behaviour.
solution: A class whose attributes/behaviour are inherited or extended by a subclass.

marking_points.criterion: Parent class from which subclass inherits.
